title: A protocol to differentiate nociceptors, mechanoreceptors, and proprioceptors from human pluripotent stem cells
protocol: Grow undifferentiated H9 hESCs in 10 mL E8 Essential Medium in a VTN-coated 10 cm dish.
Aspirate media from the cells.
Add 6 mL DPBS to the cells.
Aspirate DBPS.
Add 4 mL EDTA Dissociation solution.
Incubate for 2 min at 37°C.
Aspirate EDTA Dissociation solution.
Resuspend cells by adding 10 mL E8 Essential Medium directly to the cells.
Pipette mixture of media and cells relatively harsh (no more than five times) while rotating the dish to remove all the cells.
Add cells to a 15 mL conical tube.
Split the cells at a 1:20 ratio using E8 Essential Medium and seed them into a new VTN-coated 10 cm dish.
Check the cultures at least every two weeks for mycoplasma and other contaminants.
Use MycoAlert Mycoplasma Detection Kit (Lonza, Cat# LT07-318) to detect mycoplasma.
Differentiate hPSCs into NCCs with a SN fate.
Observe cultures on day 4; NCCs start to aggregate.
Monitor cultures daily until day 8 when dark aggregates (“ridges”) become visible under brightfield microscope.
Note that NCCs express SN markers as early as day 4.
Aspirate E8 media from the 10 cm dish of undifferentiated, ready to split hPSCs.
Wash once with approximately 10 mL DPBS.
Add 4 mL EDTA Dissociation solution to a 10-cm dish, incubate for 15 min at 37°C.
Use 10 mL DPBS to wash off the cells.
Transfer the cells into a 50 mL conical tube and add an additional 10 mL DPBS.
Spin down at 200×g for 4 min.
Resuspend in 5 mL NCC Differentiation media 1.
Count cells using a Countess II or hematocytometer.
Mix 10 μL Trypan blue with 10 μL of cell suspension.
Mix by pipetting and put 10 μL in a counting slide.
Count the cells.
Resuspend 0.5 − 1 × 10^6 cells in 500 μL TRIZOL for RNA for day 0.
Aspirate VTN from the 6-well plate.
Transfer 10.8 × 10^6 cells to a 15 mL conical tube and fill with NCC Differentiation media 1 up to 12 mL.
Plate 2 mL of the cell suspension directly onto each of the VTN-coated wells.
Incubate at 37°C for 16–20 h.
On day 1, replace media with 3 mL per well of NCC Differentiation media 1.
Take a picture for records of cell density.
High density is desired (>80%).
Incubate at 37°C for 16–20 h.
On the next day (day 2), replace media with 3 mL per well of NCC Differentiation media 2.
Change media every 2 days until day 6 for inducing mechanoreceptors or day 12 for obtaining all three neuronal types.
Harvest RNA from cells on day 8.
Aspirate the media from one well of a 4-well quality control plate.
Lysate the cells in 500 μL TRIZOL.
Avoid washing cells with PBS to prevent mRNA degradation.
Consider fixing the quality control plate for immunofluorescence staining.
Take pictures on every feeding day to monitor proper progression.
On day 6 of the NC differentiation, wash each of the three designated wells of the 6-well plate with 1 mL DPBS.
Aspirate DPBS.
Add 1 mL/well Accutase and incubate at 37°C for 20 min (or until the cells start to detach).
Add 1 mL DPBS to each well to resuspend the cells and transfer them to a 50 mL conical tube using a p1000.
Fill up with DPBS.
Centrifuge, 200×g, 5 min, RT.
Resuspend the cells in 30 mL DPBS by pipetting up to six times using a 5 mL pipette, trying to gently break up the clumps.
Add 150 μL DNaseI (from a 10 mg/mL stock) and mix by inversion.
Centrifuge, 200×g, 5 min, RT.
Resuspend in 5 mL of SN Differentiation media + 1 μM DAPT.
Gently break all the clumps by pipetting with a p1000 (<6 times).
Count cells.
Aspirate LM/FN mixture from the PO/LM/FN-coated 24-well plate.
Transfer 12 × 10^6 cells to seed one 24-well plate at a density of 250,000 cells/cm².
Fill up the cell suspension to 12 mL with SN Differentiation media + 1 μM DAPT.
Add 0.5 mL of the cell suspension to each well of the 24-well plate.
Incubate cells at 37°C for 16–20 hours.
Aspirate the media from the wells on the next day.
Add 1 mL SN Differentiation media + 1 μM DAPT per well slowly along the walls of the wells.
Replace the media every 2–3 days until day ∼30.
Remove DAPT from the SN Differentiation media after day 14 (eight days post-replating).
If a high number of non-neural ectoderm cells arise, adjust accordingly.
Wash each well with 1 mL DPBS on day 12 of NC differentiation.
Add 1 mL/well Accutase and incubate at 37°C for 20 min (or until the cells start to detach).
Add 1 mL DPBS to each well to resuspend the cells and transfer them to a 50 mL conical tube using a p1000.
Fill up with DPBS.
Centrifuge, 200×g, 5 min, RT.
Aspirate the supernatant and add 30 mL DPBS.
Resuspend the cells by pipetting up to six times using a 5 mL pipette, trying to gently break up the clumps.
Add 150 μL DNaseI (from a 10 mg/mL stock) and mix by inversion.
Centrifuge, 200×g for 5 min at RT.
Resuspend in 5 mL of SN Differentiation media + 1 μM DAPT using a 5 mL pipette.
Gently break all clumps by pipetting with a p1000 (less than 6 times).
Count cells.
Aspirate LM/FN mix from the PO/LM/FN-coated 24-well plate.
Transfer 12 × 10^6 cells to a 15 mL conical tube and fill up to 12 mL with SN Differentiation media + 1 μM DAPT.
Add 0.5 mL of cell suspension to each well of the 24-well plate.
Incubate the cells at 37°C for 16–20 hours.
Aspirate the media from the wells the next day.
Add 1 mL SN Differentiation media + 1 μM DAPT slowly along the walls of each well.
Replace the media every 2–3 days until day 30.
Change the media every five days after day 30.
Wash SNs with DPBS.
Incubate SNs at 37°C with Accutase for at least 1 hour.
Transfer cells to a 50 mL conical tube with 30 mL DPBS.
Centrifuge the tube at 200x g for 4 minutes at room temperature.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of SN Differentiation media using a p1000 micropipette.
Add 4 mL of SN Differentiation media to the resuspended cells.
Count the cells and replate at a density of 250,000 cells/cm² on a PO/LM/FN plate.
Change the media the next day after replating.
